chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: Slim drafted; Stewart joins Art Tatum in late 1941
summary: After Slim was inducted, Stewart, passed over by the draft, joined Art Tatum in Los Angeles in late 1941, staying on and off for several years.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh, yes. Let's see. Oh, that's kind of hard right now. I did meet Art Tatum.
Oh, you met Tatum in L. A.?
I met him out there. I had met him first in New York, but then that's where I joined Art Tatum.
Oh, you joined him out there.
Joined him out there after Slim had --
So you didn't have to go in the Army?
You got by that one. So now you -- so at that time you joined Tatum in late '41?
And how long were you with him?
On and off for, oh, about several years.
